what.text: This page follows refugees from El Salvador living in Italy, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3818 Salvadoran refugees in Italy, 5.6% of all refugees from El Salvador.
The United States hosts the most Salvadoran refugees, followed by Mexico, Italy and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of El Salvador with the FMLN from 1980 to 1991.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2019 to 2025, come long after that conflict ended.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1985 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 4266, at the end of 2024, and was slightly lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
These are year-end totals for Italy only, reported to UNHCR.
